metadata.title: EPUB 3.3 Error Fix Precision Guide (Hyphenated Keys)
metadata.description: 251 error codes based on EPUBCheck 5.3.0 (hyphen key format)

global_rules.standard_compliance: Strictly fix errors to comply with the W3C EPUB 3.3 standard.
global_rules.data_integrity: Never delete or modify Base64 strings inside CSS, font files, or image data.
global_rules.encoding: Ensure files remain encoded in UTF-8.
global_rules.clean_output: Do not include Markdown code blocks (```) or explanatory text in the output. Return only the modified raw code.
global_rules.action_priority: If a hint instructs 'delete', remove decisively; if it instructs 'add', add accordingly.

ACC-001.hint: Add an 'alt' attribute to all tags. If decorative, use alt="".
